plugins.name: tap
plugins.description: Local-first authenticated browser automation. Bundles the Tap MCP server (capture/verify/mark/run + saved taps as resources), the capture-replay + setup + triggers skills, and a WebFetch→tap routing hook. Record a repeated logged-in browser task once; replay it forever in your own Chrome as a deterministic program at zero LLM tokens — credentials never leave your machine. For logged-in sites, say "set up tap" — the setup skill registers the Chrome bridge from the npx-downloaded engine and opens the extension page.
